title: Raymond James’ New Capital Raising Option So Far 'Oversubscribed'
DTCC rolls out tokenized stocks trading plan: 50+ firms & timeline explained
content:
What if tokenized stocks and bonds start trading inside the same system that already handles over $114T in global securities? That shift is now getting a timeline.

The DTCC announced on Monday that its DTC tokenization service will begin limited trading of tokenized securities in July 2026, followed by a full launch in October 2026.

This will bring tokenized equities [https://seekingalpha.com/article/4897897-galaxy-digital-stock-tokenization-may-not-be-easy], ETFs, and Treasuries into existing market infrastructure, rather than on separate blockchain-only platforms.

Importantly, these assets will still carry full investor rights and protections while being represented in digital form.

The company also said these assets will remain custodied within its system but will now be enabled for digital trading and settlement across interoperable blockchain networks.

More than 50 financial firms are already involved through DTCC’s Industry Working Group. Key participants include Bank of America [https://seekingalpha.com/news/4578991-bank-of-america-declares-0_28-dividend] (BAC [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/BAC]), BlackRock (BLK [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/BLK]), JPMorgan (JPM [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/JPM]), Charles Schwab (SCHW [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/SCHW]), Goldman Sachs (GS [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/GS]), Morgan Stanley (MS [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/MS]), Nasdaq (NDAQ [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/NDAQ]), Circle (CRCL [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/CRCL]), HSBC (HSBC [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/HSBC]), Robinhood (HOOD [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/HOOD]), Invesco (IVZ [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/IVZ]), Tel-Aviv Stock Exchange (TVAVF [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/TVAVF]), Ondo Finance (ONDO-USD [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/ONDO-USD]), Raymond James (RJF [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/RJF]), Jefferies Financial Group (JEF [https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/JEF]), and others across traditional finance and crypto infrastructure.

Moreover, DTCC CEO Frank La Salla said the goal is to “bridge TradFi and DeFi” and unlock liquidity, transparency, and efficiency through tokenization.

Brian Steele, president of Clearing & Securities Services, added that the system is being built to scale where liquidity already exists. Nadine Chakar, Global Head of Digital Assets, said it is a key step toward a Web3-based financial infrastructure.

With testing in 2026, DTCC is positioning tokenization not as a parallel market but as the next layer of the existing financial system.

title: Raymond James Starts Insmed (INSM) at Outperform, Citing Limited Competition
content:
Insmed Incorporated (NASDAQ:INSM) is one of the Stocks that Billionaire Druckenmiller and Jim Cramer like.Raymond James Starts Insmed (INSM) at Outperform, Citing Limited Competition

On April 9, 2026, Raymond James initiated coverage of Insmed Incorporated (NASDAQ:INSM) with an Outperform rating. The firm’s analyst set a price target of $200 on the stock. According to the analyst’s research note, the early launch of Brinsupri has materially de-risked the company’s trajectory. The firm described it as one of the strongest inflammation and immunology debuts ever and cited a massive underserved market and limited competition for the drug.

In a separate development, on April 14, 2026, RBC Capital raised its price target on Insmed Incorporated (NASDAQ:INSM) from $212 to $216 while maintaining an Outperform rating on the company’s stock. RBC Capital told investors that, in a survey of 50 physicians conducted by the firm, high satisfaction was noted with Brinsupri’s clinical profile. Physicians expect to significantly increase prescriptions, noting that the eligible patient population is expanding dramatically. With these findings, the analyst believes the drug’s strong growth in the immunology market is reinforced.

Druckenmiller has been one of the most aggressive accumulators of Insmed Incorporated (NASDAQ:INSM) across consecutive quarters, building it into a top-three position, while Cramer believes that the stock is worth following:

Still, this one is worth keeping an eye on.

Founded in 1988, Insmed Incorporated (NASDAQ:INSM) is a global biopharmaceutical company. Headquartered in New Jersey, the company specializes in pulmonary conditions, particularly those involving chronic airway inflammation and infectious diseases.

title: NRG Energy (NRG) Price Target Cut by $10 at Raymond James
content:
NRG Energy, Inc. (NYSE:NRG) is included among the 10 Best Electrical Infrastructure Stocks to Buy According to Hedge Funds.NRG Energy (NRG) Price Target Cut by $10 at Raymond James

NRG Energy, Inc. (NYSE:NRG) delivers innovative natural gas, electricity, and smart home solutions to customers large and small across North America.

On April 27, Raymond James trimmed its price target on NRG Energy, Inc. (NYSE:NRG) from $220 to $210, but maintained a ‘Strong Buy’ rating on the shares. The lowered target still indicates an upside of almost 41% from the current price levels.

Raymond James expects the IPP group to report mixed earnings in Q1, with minimal spillover to the broader sector. The analyst expects NRG Energy, Inc. (NYSE:NRG) to report weaker near-term results, driven by the softer ERCOT weather, reduced load, and lower power prices. The impact of these factors is likely to vary by company, depending on the mix of their retail and supply structure.

NRG Energy, Inc. (NYSE:NRG) is set to report its Q1 2026 results on May 6. The company is targeting an adjusted EBITDA of $5.575 billion and adjusted net income of $1.9 billion for FY 2026. Moreover, adjusted EPS for the year is expected to come in at $8.90 per share, while free cash flow before growth is projected to be $3.05 billion.

title: DH Investment Consulting of Raymond James Has Been Named as One of Nation’s Top DC Advisor Teams
content:

Led by Gary Handler, Managing Director, and Lisa Detanna, Managing Director, DH Consulting Group of Raymond James was selected for its demonstrated leadership, deep expertise, and commitment to delivering strategic, participant‑focused retirement plan solutions for plan sponsors across the country.

"This recognition reflects the collective effort of our entire team and our shared commitment to helping organizations build stronger retirement outcomes," said Gary Handler, Managing Director of DH Consulting Group of Raymond James. "We are honored to be acknowledged by NAPA and remain focused on providing thoughtful guidance and exceptional service to our clients."

NAPA’s Top DC Advisor Teams designation highlights advisory teams that exhibit industry leadership, innovation, and dedication to advancing best practices in defined contribution plans. The award underscores DH Consulting Group’s ongoing focus on plan design, fiduciary governance, investment oversight, participant engagement, and education.

"Helping employers and participants navigate the complexities of retirement planning is both our responsibility and our passion," said Lisa Detanna. "Being recognized as a Top DC Advisor Team reinforces the importance of the work we do every day and the trust our clients place in us."

This honor adds to DH Consulting Group’s reputation as a trusted advisor to plan sponsors seeking to enhance retirement readiness and strengthen outcomes for their employees.

Join us in congratulating Gary, Lisa and entire DH Consulting Group team on this prestigious award.
